core_expression.whole_expression_rule: No part of the bracketed expression may be removed without deforming the RT expression.
not_equal_to: a direct identity between QM and GR

interpretation.Affect|Effect: The implicit universal meta-relation, loosely continuous influence | discrete realization.
interpretation.QM|GR: A projection-domain relation arising through a domain/scale/orientation slice.
interpretation.<*>_x: Typed coupling preserving the inseparability of meta-relation and projection-relation.

whole_expression_primacy.rule: The bracketed RT expression is the admissible unit of analysis.
whole_expression_primacy.consequence: Internal aspect positions may be named, but not granted priority over the whole expression.
whole_expression_primacy.collapse_behavior: Once admissibly closed, an RT expression may be treated as a single variable in higher-order RT expressions.

nesting_rule.reading: Admissible RT closures compose by accumulating closure depth while preserving RT-ness.
nesting_rule.scale_rule: At one scale, an RT contains aspects; at the next scale, the entire RT behaves as one collapsible variable.

projection_family.claim: A|E can become implicit and universal, with admissibility as one projection of A|E.

domain_scale_orientation_dependence.principle: The exact behavior of RT and A|E depends on domain, scale, and orientation slice.
domain_scale_orientation_dependence.important_constraint: No projection exhausts the RT expression.

qm_gr_bridge_reading.caution: This is not a physics claim yet.
qm_gr_bridge_reading.structural_reading: Affect|Effect is the deeper relation from which QM-like and GR-like projection families may arise.
qm_gr_bridge_reading.qm_like_role: Discrete realization through effect coupled with exclusion.
qm_gr_bridge_reading.gr_like_role: Continuous relational/geodesic structure between Affect and Addition.

exclusion_tests.remove_AffectEffect: QM|GR loses the meta-domain relation that makes it an RT projection.
exclusion_tests.remove_QMGR: Affect|Effect loses the projection-domain contrast needed for this RT slice.
exclusion_tests.remove_coupling: The expression splits into unrelated pairs and ceases to be one RT window.
exclusion_tests.collapse_QM_GR_identity: Forbidden; QM and GR remain distinct projection positions.
exclusion_tests.collapse_Affect_Effect_identity: Forbidden; Affect and Effect remain distinguishable aspect positions.

forbidden_use: claim that QM or GR has been derived

short_plain_language_summary: RT is being treated as a whole, nestable, collapsible process-expression. A|E may be the implicit universal meta-relation inside RT, with admissibility, core expression, metric structure, topology, and QM/GR-like relations appearing as domain-scale-orientation projections. The candidate expression RT := [Affect|Effect <*>_x QM|GR] must be preserved as a whole; no part can be removed without deforming the expression.
